blockers_runtime_kernel_required.why: no grouped/top-k expert GEMM dispatch kernel; the 512 routed experts are stored + quantized, dispatch is unimplemented

blockers_runtime_kernel_required.scope: the separate .ngram store (128 shards) + layer-1 PLE projection
blockers_runtime_kernel_required.why: no SSD demand-paging + trigram-index lookup runtime; the store is built and quantized, the reader/eviction is unimplemented
no hyper-connection mixing kernel; tensors are stored BF16
no indexer scoring/selection kernel; projections stored BF16
attention projections stored separately (q/k/v) to encode no head-interleaving assumption; the mRoPE-attention kernel is unimplemented
no multi-token-prediction decode path; tensors are stored BF16/NVFP4

blockers_runtime_kernel_required.scope: every NVFP4 weight (K=2560 HIDDEN, K=640 KV)
blockers_runtime_kernel_required.why: the Blackwell W4A4 kernel only supports K in {5120,6144,17408}; Flash-Next K=2560 and K=640 are NEITHER -- the packed weights are correct, a K=2560/640 W4A4 kernel is required
